title: Drop & Grow
description: Automatically plants dropped saplings. A great quality-of-life feature for clean inventories and farm automation that fits perfectly into vanilla survival
body:
**Drop & Grow** is a Minecraft data pack that introduces a seamless, automatic sapling-planting mechanic, making it a perfect organic addition to the vanilla game.


 **What does it do?**
Whenever a tree sapling drops onto the ground (for example, from decaying leaves after you chop down a tree), the data pack will automatically plant it on the block beneath it, provided it is a valid dirt or grass block.


 **Why should you download it?**
- Quality of Life: Tired of manually replanting forests? Let the data pack do the work for you.
- Inventory Management: Prevents unwanted saplings from cluttering your inventory while you're gathering wood.
- Farm Potential: Opens up new possibilities for designing semi-automatic tree farms and unique mechanics.
- Vanilla-Friendly: The pack maintains the vanilla balance, doesn't break the game's economy, and is perfect for standard survival playthroughs.

### **Important Information:**
- Supported Versions: Compatible with almost all Minecraft versions from 1.14 up to the latest releases.
- Requirements: This is a purely vanilla data pack; no additional mods or plugins are required to make it work.
